title: Foundations of PBLS
objectives: Recognize situations requiring Pediatric Basic Life Support
Classify children into the appropriate PBLS age groups
Identify children at risk of pediatric cardiac arrest
Interpret the physiological changes leading to pediatric cardiac arrest
Differentiate pediatric cardiac arrest from adult cardiac arrest
Distinguish between infant and child PBLS algorithms
Differentiate the indications of NRP and PBLS
Select the appropriate PBLS approach based on age and clinical condition
Apply PBLS concepts in game-based clinical scenarios
Analyse case-based situations to determine when PBLS should be initiated
authoringNote: No badge for the prelevel, per the corrected document. Two objectives are currently unused by any seeded item: 'Distinguish between infant and child PBLS algorithms' and 'Apply PBLS concepts in game-based clinical scenarios'.

title: Recognition of pediatric cardiac arrest
objectives: Ensure scene safety
Assess responsiveness
Activate emergency response
Assess breathing and pulse simultaneously within 10 seconds
Recognize respiratory and cardiac arrest
Decide when to start CPR
Differentiate respiratory distress, failure, shock and cardiac arrest

title: High quality CPR
objectives: Describe the Paediatric Chain of Survival, including the separate out-of-hospital and in-hospital chains
Recognise when CPR is needed
Initiate high-quality CPR
Differentiate infant and child CPR techniques
Perform single-rescuer 30:2 and two-rescuer 15:2 CPR
Follow the PBLS algorithm correctly

title: AED use and airway obstruction management
objectives: Identify when an AED should be used
Select appropriate paediatric pads and use anterior-posterior placement for infants
Correctly place AED pads
Follow AED prompts safely and resume CPR immediately after shock
Differentiate AED use in infants and children
Distinguish mild from severe foreign body airway obstruction
Apply the back-blows-first approach for conscious children aged 1 year and above
Apply back blows and chest thrusts for conscious infants under 1 year
Manage foreign body airway obstruction when the victim becomes unconscious by beginning CPR
authoringNote: Level is now fully authored, 21 questions. Status moved from draft to published.

title: Team dynamics
objectives: Identify the principles of effective team dynamics during paediatric resuscitation
Demonstrate appropriate leadership behaviours
Assign roles and responsibilities effectively
Apply closed-loop communication during CPR
Demonstrate situational awareness during resuscitation
Apply assertive communication when a concern is identified
